column3: NASB renders “access” as “our introduction,” “have stood” as “stand,” and “boast” as “exult.”
NASB renders “glory” as “exult,” adds “our,” and renders “produces” as “brings about.”
NASB follows the critical text; “without strength” is rendered “helpless,” and it reorders the verse.
NASB renders “in His life” as “by His life.”
NASB renders “passed” as “spread” and ends the verse with a dash.
NASB renders “transgression” as “offense” and “the coming One” as “Him who was to come.”
NASB renders “trespass” as “transgression” and “gift” as “free gift,” and it reorders the verse.
NASB expands the verse with “that which came,” “on the one hand … on the other hand,” “arose,” and “resulting in.”
NASB renders “entered” as “came in,” “abound” as “increase,” and “overabounded” as “abounded all the more.”
